name: BlueHill Payments
long_description:
BlueHill replaces the patchwork of tools you use to manage clients. Instead of bouncing between a project management app, a shared inbox, a portal solution, and a spreadsheet to track onboarding — BlueHill brings it all into one platform. Your team gets built-in email, structured onboarding workflows, project management, and a complete history of every client interaction. No more lost context, no more switching between tabs, and no more wondering who said what to which client.

Your clients get a branded portal experience where they can communicate with your team, track progress, and access everything they need — without the confusion of scattered tools and login links. Whether you're onboarding a new client, managing an ongoing project, or following up on a conversation from three months ago, BlueHill keeps everything connected so your team stays aligned and every client feels taken care of.
one_liner: Client management, communication, and projects in one platform.

launches.title: BlueHill Payments 💳 - Payment Workflows For Scale
launches.tagline: Lower merchant fees and increase payment acceptance by choosing the right payment processor to use for each transaction
launches.body:
## **TL;DR:**

BlueHill makes it easy to connect to different payment service providers and start taking digital payments. We do this by integrating with different payment gateways and offering you the best rates across all payment options for each transaction.

## **🤕 The Problem:**

* As businesses scale, they begin to outgrow their payment systems, leaving them to use multiple tools and software to manage their revenue operations.
* Maintaining multiple systems increases vendor lock-in and forces businesses to spend more on fees when accepting digital payments.
* It’s difficult to get lifecycle analytics across multiple payment service providers

## **🤩 The Solution - BlueHill**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64913&key=user_uploads/927793/19dd5cc9-72bb-4988-97ea-999e0bfdec8c)

* ✅  Manage all of your revenue and transactions in one place
* ✅  Use your existing payment service providers
* ✅  See customer transaction history, LTV, and revenue graphs in real time
* ✅  Save time and increase billing efficiency

### **🧠 Intelligent Routing Platform:**

BlueHill can support all your payment-related business needs, whether its fast settlement, lower fees or tiered billing with an easy-to-use Dashboard or API. Route transactions to service providers based on rates and business priorities.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64913&key=user_uploads/927793/b3438206-ff38-46e7-9479-7456c3247e52)

## **🚀 Our Ask - Join our Pilot**

* We want you! Interested in BlueHill’s solution? Contact us at [founders@bluehillpayments.com](mailto:founders@bluehillpayments.com) or go to <https://bluehillpayments.com>
* Additionally, **if you know any businesses looking to streamline their complex payment operations** and are willing to make an intro please **email us directly**. Any help is appreciated.
